beforeYouTake: Use only when prescribed for you. Antibiotics do not treat colds or flu.
Follow the prescribed course. Do not share antibiotics or keep leftovers for a future illness.
Tell your doctor if you have heart rhythm problems.
Tell your pharmacist about allergies and every medicine or supplement you take.

stopAndGetHelp: You have severe or bloody diarrhoea during or after antibiotic treatment.
Your lips, mouth or throat swell, or breathing becomes difficult: seek emergency help.
You faint or develop a new fast or irregular heartbeat.
